entities.name: Sidelink UE capability transfer
entities.description: Procedure for transferring sidelink UE capability information for unicast from one UE to another initiating UE.

entities.name: UECapabilityEnquirySidelink
entities.description: Message sent to request sidelink UE capability information.

entities.name: UECapabilityInformationSidelink
entities.description: Message containing the sidelink UE capability information response.

entities.name: Sidelink UE capability information
entities.description: Information element containing UE sidelink capability details for unicast communication.

relations.description: The capability transfer procedure includes sending the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message.
The capability transfer procedure includes sending the UECapabilityInformationSidelink message.
The UECapabilityInformationSidelink message contains the sidelink UE capability information IE.
